svg.text: Work the steps in order. Every part buys from the Step 1 era and fills the Step 5 stations. Carry each part’s compartments, power and cost to Step 16.
Descriptor Speed is capped at half the DEX mod (min 1). Check it in Step 8.
First station of each job free · Pilot = Helm + Gunner · nobody on a job = automate it
Speed limit: descriptor Speed ≤ half DEX mod (min 1). Drop any extra.
The Navigator’s station reads the sensors and runs the comms.
Siege Weapons · main gun faces bow
Tiny guns add no crew; bigger ones fire from a Step 5 Gunner or are automated.
Ship STR meets the armor’s STR Needed
Every crewed part has a Step 5 station, or is automated
Bridge, sensors, power, engine, somewhere to live
A magazine for every gun that needs one
